xv6rhfcx.baseName: Walplus Polyester Christmas Tree Skirt with Sock - Red - 122 cm
xv6rhfcx.variantName: Walplus Polyester Christmas Tree Skirt with Sock - Red - 122 cm
xv6rhfcx.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree skirt makes your Christmas tree look more luxurious. So, you can put decorative items you like on it. This soft and warm tree base features snow patterns, which match the festival atmosphere. It also comes with matching Christmas sock, which can be filled with candy, gifts, etc. The tree decoration is easy to fold when not in use, and you can use it next year. Product Specifications Colour: Red Material: Fabric (100% polyester) Diameter: 122 cm Middle hole diameter: 10 cm Easy to fold Features snow pattern Includes a Christmas sock This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets. Manufacturer Name: WALPLUS Address: Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom Contact: customer.service@walplus.com
